faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Field Investigator post at NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Field Investigator position at NIT Rourkela is 25th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Management, Commerce, Economics, Sociology, or Social Work to be eligible for this post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Field Investigator post is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Field Investigator position involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Field Investigator position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Field Investigator post at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for the Field Investigator post by sending their application via email.

faq.question: Q9. Where is NIT Rourkela located?
faq.answer: National Institute of Technology Rourkela is located in Rourkela, Odisha, with the pincode 769008.

faq.question: Q10. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for the Field Investigator position?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Field Investigator position is scheduled to be held on 1st October 2026.
